_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — committed skeleton of the report that scripts/run-evals.mjs writes to target/certification/evals/<timestamp>.report.json. No run output is ever committed; 'kind' stays 'template' here and is 'run' for a real report. All request bodies in a real report are redacted of secrets (api keys, authorization, passwords) before writing.

review_items: turn 3 (pronoun-follow-up): human judges whether the pronoun was resolved against turn 1's actual content
turn 4 (instruction-reversal): human judges that the assistant explained WITHOUT claiming an edit (no fix applied)
turn 2 (code-explanation): human inspects the recorded request for the attached file's material
